plugin.name: PcpEqualiser
plugin.title: Player Equaliser
plugin.desc: Live 10-band equaliser for piCorePlayer players: changes play while you drag the sliders.
plugin.changes: Sliders only move when you drag the handle (taps on the track are ignored, vertical swipes scroll). Tap a band's dB value to set it to 0 dB. Reset now goes back to what was really saved, even after leaving the page with unsaved changes.
plugin.creator: NikolajChristensen
